lines.text: At a busy street market, @sai_front holds up a ripe mango, sniffs it, and hands coins to the stallholder.

new_beats.text: Fresh picks, fair prices, every single day.

writes.note: I added a short VO line over the shot and kept your action and direction as they were.

reply.rationale: The VO is one short line of about seven words, so it fits the shot and a 15 s ad. It adds the retail message without repeating the action.
